tasks.title: Render content.json into a static dist/index.html with build.mjs

acceptance_criteria.text: `build.mjs` exists at the project root and `node build.mjs` with a valid `content.json` exits 0 and writes `dist/index.html` (covers: REQ-1, REQ-10)
The output has one `<style>` block and no `<script>`, no `on*=` attribute, no `<link>` and no `src=` (covers: REQ-2)

acceptance_criteria: `build.mjs` imports only `node:` builtins and makes no network calls (TS-NOGO-01)

acceptance_criteria.text: A project titled `Rock & Roll` appears as `<b>Rock & Roll</b>` with no raw `` from content (covers: REQ-14)
`<title>` equals `name`, and the page has exactly one `<h1>` whose text is `name`, with the tagline after it (covers: REQ-4, REQ-9)
Sections appear in order h1+tagline, About (with the `about` text), Projects, Contact (covers: REQ-5, REQ-8)
Each project renders as one card in array order; its title is an `<a href>` to its `url` (covers: REQ-6)
`CONTENT_FILE=<tmp>/c.json OUT_DIR=<tmp>/out node build.mjs` reads that file and writes `<tmp>/out/index.html` (covers: REQ-11)
Two consecutive builds of the same content produce byte-identical files (covers: REQ-17)

acceptance_criteria: The content file's bytes are unchanged after a build (TS-NOGO-03)

acceptance_criteria.text: A project with no `url` (or a blank or non-`http(s)` url such as `javascript:alert(1)`) renders its title as plain text: no `<a>`, no `href="#"`, no `href=""` (covers: REQ-12)
`projects: []` or absent → the Projects section contains "Projects are coming soon." and no `<ul>`/`<li>` (covers: REQ-13)

acceptance_criteria: Absent `tagline`, `about` or `contact.email` → no crash; that element is omitted

tasks.title: Reject missing or invalid content with exit 1, one stderr line, nothing written

acceptance_criteria.text: A missing content file → exit 1, exactly one stderr line naming the path, no `index.html` and no output dir created (covers: REQ-15)
An unparsable file (`{not json`) or a non-object root (`null`, `[]`) → exit 1, one stderr line, nothing written (covers: REQ-15, REQ-3)
Missing, non-string or blank `name` → exit 1, one stderr line mentioning `name`, nothing written (covers: REQ-16, REQ-3)
stderr never contains a stack trace (no line starting with `    at `) (covers: REQ-15)

tasks.title: Add a node --test suite that drives build.mjs against throwaway content files

acceptance_criteria.text: `node --test` exits 0 from the project root (covers: REQ-21)
The suite has one test per Test Surface row of both use cases, each named by its row id (covers: REQ-21)
Tests never read or write the real `content.json` or `dist/` (covers: REQ-21)
